conclusions.mapdn: All four candidates saturate voltage compliance under new one-step local memory and source-iterative controls. Retain 33 Feb3 only as a joint voltage-constraint/loss-reduction candidate, retract old fixed-gain voltage-gap difficulty claim; reference is full-information and not a certificate of locally attainable optimum.
conclusions.powergym: 34Bus remaining strong-search noncompliance is confined to tiny sourcebus/800 upstream boundary excess, so strict CR cannot demonstrate substantive sustained feeder-control difficulty. 123Bus standard is saturated even by constant device settings. Separate 2.5x stress shows storage contribution but has no complete voltage-feasible reference. Do not freeze a formal mixed-device case from these results.
conclusions.storage: Net energy is accepted within a per-battery 1 kWh tolerance, not mathematically exact energy neutrality. Storage dispatch is searched on the fixed oracle-day-idle device plan.
